newsitem.title: THAILAND: Finance One falls early, losses pared.
newsitem.headline: Finance One falls early, losses pared.

text.p: Shares of Thailand's ailing Finance One Plc posted lighter losses than expected early on Wednesday as the shares traded ex-rights.

By 0338 GMT the stock had lost 0.20 baht to 5.50 and topped the actives list. The troubled firm had offered two new shares for one at 7.50 baht per share to raise 8.28 billion baht as ordered by the central bank recently.
The Bank of Thailand had guaranteed to buy all unsold shares.

"I think investors believe that if they buy now and then let the Bank of Thailand take the new shares the book value will increase to around six baht from the current 3.40 or so," said a trader at a Thai Military Bank affiliate.
